idea-plugin.name: Crypto Codec Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
Crypto Codec Toolkit — Base58 / Base58Check / Base32 / hex, offline

The encodings general "string manipulation" plugins don't cover, for people who work with crypto and wire formats: Base58 and Base58Check (Bitcoin addresses, WIF keys, extended keys), Base32 (RFC 4648) and hex. Convert between any of them in a tool window, fully offline — an address, a payload or a key never has to be pasted into a web codec.

  • Any-to-any — pick a From and a To representation (Text / Hex / Base58 / Base58Check / Base32); the value is decoded to bytes and re-encoded. e.g. Hex → Base58Check to build an address, or Base58Check → Hex to see a decoded payload.
  • Base58Check appends and verifies the 4-byte double-SHA-256 checksum, so a bad address is rejected instead of silently decoded.
  • Deterministic & offline — no telemetry, no network. The same validated engine behind the Kassi fintech tools (its Bitcoin Base58Check and Base32 are anchored to published test vectors).

Open it from View ▸ Tool Windows ▸ Codec.

More Kassi tools for QA & fintech: Kassi Test Data, Checksum & Regex Playground.

Source, issues & docs: github.com/VadimToptunov/kassi-plugins
